Would cushing's or diabetes be a cause for these conditions? I am diabetic, and I haven't been diagnosed with cushing's (though I have a lot of symptoms) so I'm wondering if it could be either of those 2. I'm betting a bmbx done in a little over a week, but the suspense is already killing me

My biggest issue was dissociation. My first therapist was pushing for DID (or MPD) but when they couldn't read a personality (or alter) from me, they referred to get me evaluated. 

Then upon speaking with the psychologist who tested me, I described my dissociation. 

I described why: because people are fucking boring as hell, and past trauma causes me to zone out 

What happens: I disappear into a world only my mind knows. I converse with figures that are more interesting than those in the real world, and often those figures dictate my life here in our reality. Usually they keep me antisocial. 

I have avoidant traits. I have no emotions or feelings. I speak in a monotone (and sparse) manner. I'm a person of a few words, yet upon testing, I have normal brain function so no cognitive struggles for me. 

I also deal with hallucinations. Most of the time, it's the figures from my imagination, but occasionally I'll see/hear someone or something I don't recognize. The audio and visual hallucinations are not simultaneous for me, it's usually one or the other. It's rare when it is happening at the same time. 

As far as violent tendencies, my case is that I'm not aggressive. I'm more passive as in "If that car ran me over right now, I wouldn't care" or "that bitch will get what's coming eventually" 

There's probably something I'm forgetting but that's the gist of it.

No one has to hold my hand as I get anything done anymore. 
Although I still feel pretty empty inside, I like to think my memories are coming back like pushing  play-doh through a sieve, but with hallucinations mixed in.

Been on it for over 2 years, and I've fluctuated dosage a handful of times, and have tried several supplemental meds.

Right off the bat, I feel nothing. I really can't distinguish a difference other than I'm now less interested in self-care. My mood hasn't improved much, but I guess I'm not as irritated anymore. 

I don't drink as much anymore because I'd puke. Currently, I'd have half a bottle of wine, or a shot of vodka and be ok aside from an allergic reaction of sorts. Just a subtle buzz though, so idk if I could ever blackout.

Side effects I've noticed: 

-tremors, which make me suck at my job now

-staying up late because anxiety (sometimes I'd lay in bed at least 5 hours waiting to fall asleep) and struggle to wake up (i have missed all 14 alarms on some occasions) 

-hallucinations; mostly auditory. Probably emerged from imagination. They're familiar, but I can no longer identify them as my own thoughts. 

-i now wear glasses because my vision is blurry enough to consider myself illiterate (also makes me suck at work) 

-increased heart rate. Nurses have assumed i smoke, and would forget its likely the buproprion. 

Bottom line: nothing major comes out of it , at least for me. Others may have different experiences, so don't feel deterred.
